shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Arbitrary font sizes (like text-[10px], text-[11px]) and raw custom values are not allowed. Follow cm-beetle typography rules (min font size text-sm/text-xs) and theme tokens.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Brand colors are Emerald and Teal only. Cyan, purple, and sky are strictly forbidden in cm-beetle UI.
